mrr_arithmetic_verification.verification_explanation: Dev and Test sets evaluate to identical MRRs (0.8944) due to an exact arithmetic coincidence: both sets sum to 161/6 (~26.833333) across 30 answerable queries. Dev had 26 rank-1s, 1 rank-2, 1 rank-3, and 2 misses. Test had 24 rank-1s, 5 rank-2s, 1 rank-3, and 0 misses.
